name: glove_planar_poses_50
description: Set D: 50 static single-plane poses for the XR glove, gloves on, no camera, each held still; written by scripts/leap/glove_planar_poses.py, ranges and exclusions in protocols/glove_planar_poses_50.csv. Record with scripts/glove/record_poses.py --pose-list this file.
setup: gloves on, no camera: XR Train open and streaming, the hand held still in the pose for the 5 s of the take
plane: each digit moves only in its own flexion-extension plane: fingers side by side (spread together), wrist neutral, thumb bent or straight in its own plane

items.label: middle tip curl, others straight
items.shape: only the middle finger with PIP and DIP half bent and its MCP straight; the other three straight and together, thumb straight in the palm plane
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight
